arguments.analyst: R3: latest observations favor surface-charge/loop positions: E115A (O6, 3.614) and K209N (O7, 3.652) alone beat most multi-edit combos; K107R (O8) and N23S (O10) are near-baseline. Hypothesis: conservative single-charge swaps at exposed positions (E115, K209, K156) help; K107 mutations and F27L/P-insertion edits hurt.
arguments.hypothesis: Conservative charge-reversal/surface edits (E142G:K156R, K156R:T230N, K209N-containing) outperform designs with K107E or proline insertions (L7P, L141P, K79R:D180V:L194P).

decision.critic: Estimates cluster ~3.51-3.57, differences within uncertainty; C01/C07 identical scores, so ranking rests weakly on K209N observation O7.
